events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched in the USA on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music? On this day in 1981, a channel launched that changed music forever. Its first video? A rather ironic choice...

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, featuring tracks like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from this absolute masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, concluded on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music that defined a generation. On this day in 1969, Woodstock wrapped up, leaving an indelible mark on culture. Wish you were there?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today. His music and legacy continue to shake up the world.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the lyrical genius Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His impact on hip-hop and culture remains profound.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Bday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! Still as cool and captivating as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Bday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975, a song that continues to inspire peace worldwide.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song with a message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Original iPod
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, Apple introduced the original iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing music consumption forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is officially James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of music legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Bday
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Bday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?
